title: RWB-DM-010: the owner of the document records, the legacy dump, the handover and the legacy retention period are not specified for the realigned split
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Data Migration Stories v3.md (RWB-DM-010); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P1 Recovery data engine v3.md (A2.2); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P1 Recovery data engine v3.md (T3.6, T3.2)
section: 11 Data; 12.1 REST operations provided; 12.7 Tables owned; 12.8 Contract fakes; 19 Out of scope
description: RWB-DM-010 asks for the migration of the documents and the extracted fields of the open cases, and names recovery_case, document and document_field as its data, but no source states which of the 19 services holds document, document_field and document_custody after D-RCV-60, where the legacy Workbench cutover dump comes from, what its format is, where the handover lands, or how long the legacy tables stay read-only. The legacy story records no endpoint for the migration ('No endpoint in this story'), gives document_field a field range DF-DOC-012 to DF-DOC-035 that overlaps the document range DF-DOC-001 to DF-DOC-033, and gives no retention period. The story resolves the ownership from the Ownership Map (P5 rwb-document for the three document entities, P3 rwb-case for recovery_case), takes the extract-then-hand-over shape, copies the overlapping field range unchanged, and writes 'Not specified in the source documents (CG-B2-P1-009-1; ASM-B2-P1-009-1)' wherever the dump source, the handover location or the retention period would be.
evidence: RWB-DM-010 Data table names recovery_case DF-CAS-001 to DF-CAS-055, document DF-DOC-001 to DF-DOC-033 and document_field DF-DOC-012 to DF-DOC-035; RWB-DM-010 Endpoints: 'No endpoint in this story. The migration is a cutover step run by the recovery service identity, and its breaks are listed on the reconciliation extract.'; FSD P1 v3 A2.2 gives DP10 Documents and extracted fields the Workbench as system of record with document, document_field, document_custody; TSD P1 v3 T3.6 lists the Workbench tables P1 owns and names no document table of any kind; TSD P1 v3 T3.2 gives the per-service Flyway sequence but no cutover dump, handover location or retention period.
owner_role: Data steward and data product owner (RW-DATASTEW) with the rwb-document service owner and the ACE team lead
proposed: Accept the Ownership Map split: rwb-source-data extracts and hands over, rwb-document loads into rwb_document on its own sequence, rwb-case holds recovery_case. Read the dump once from the legacy Workbench cutover dump into a file with a checksum, keep the legacy field range unchanged, and record the source, the handover location and the retention period in the cutover record of the release pipeline at the wave 4 entry check.
